decisions.reason: The plug-in product line remains a low-cost extension of the established format portfolio with unresolved market demand, so the option stays open.
The building digital twin service still targets an uncertain emerging market and the option remains inexpensive relative to its potential, so it is kept for another period.
After two years without a clear value signal and with a redundant identity service in the portfolio, the option no longer justifies its continuation cost and is abandoned.
The open GIS framework is central to the firm's component strategy and has low continuation costs, so the option remains open.
The identity and access service for GIS applications is close to the established offer and has shown enough fit with the announced launch, so it is kept.
The geodata business process consulting workshop is newly launched and still building visibility, so the firm keeps the option while its prospects remain uncertain.
